metadata.corpus_methodology_note: Separate 48-sample holdout batch authored from pre-registered construct and sampling rubrics without detector predictions. One independent reviewer, blinded to expected labels and detector output, reviewed all 48 samples before unblinding: 47 binary agreements, one disagreement, and no abstentions. The malformed-schema disagreement was adjudicated under the frozen security-review rubric and retained transparently.
metadata.source_license_policy: Repository-authored synthetic and transparently paired-derived inert metadata distributed under the project MIT license; no external service was contacted and no third-party, private, personal, credential, or proprietary content is included.
